column2: Tap the “Threader” button to select the tower

Tap and empty cell to place the Threader.
Threaders are attack towers.
Vaults are defences towers. Use them to create walls and mazes to slow down enemies

Defend the Repo from enemy agents.
If an enemy reaches the Repo you will lose a Core.

If you lose too many Cores, the Repo will start to permanently lose data.
If you lose them all, the level will be failed.

Tap to collect a Blueprint.
Blueprints unlock new towers.

Earn “Bits” for completing levels.
You can use Bits to unlock tower upgrades.
